‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto, ‘I’m swamped by rebirth, old age, and death; by sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress.
